Subject: Discovery follow-up: engagement playbook (draft MAP attached)

Hi Janelle / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo today — great context on the telemetry and where latency matters most for clinician workflows. Per our call I put together a first-pass engagement playbook (draft MAP) with proposed milestones, owners and a tentative target close. High level:

- Target close: 2027-05-28 (we flagged procurement + SOC2 evidence as dependencies)
- Key milestones: technical evaluation, security review, procurement SOW review, pilot kickoff, pilot completion
- Suggested owners: Arcturus = Security/Procurement; Redwood = AE/Delivery/Support leads

Action items for this week: please review the attached MAP and confirm owners for the security questionnaire and procurement review. I’ve also noted technical dependencies (EHR integration window, sandbox data access).

Attachments: [Attachment: Arcturus_MAP_v1.0.xlsx (12KB)]

Next steps
- Janelle: confirm procurement contact and internal timeline by Tue 4/13
- Tom: confirm sandbox access window
- Karthik: I’ll loop you on contract conversations once procurement is in the thread

Thanks — I’ll send a short weekly checkpoint on Fridays to keep the plan current.

Best,
